discovery_method_note: WebSearch session budget was exhausted early (shared session) and search engines (DuckDuckGo, Brave, Qwant, Bing) served bot challenges or junk; discovery used retailer product sitemaps (keyword scan of product URLs, up to 80 sitemap files per site) and retailer site-search pages. Several Shopify stores answered HTTP 429 'Verifying your connection' on this egress (not bypassed).

queries: product-sitemap URL scan with regex 'fructo|fruit-sugar|inulin|yolk|egg-powder|cream-powder|dried-cream|heavy-cream|powdered-cream' on shoprite.com.gh, ernestchemists.com.gh, melcom.com
site search 'fructose', 'inulin', 'egg yolk powder', 'cream powder' on shoprite.com.gh and ernestchemists.com.gh
sources_tried: shoprite.com.gh (supermarket) - sitemap scanned (no match); site search is JS-rendered (not readable)
ernestchemists.com.gh (pharmacy chain) - sitemap partly unreadable; site search 'cream powder' returned no products, other searches failed to connect
melcom.com (department store/grocer) - sitemap holds category pages only (weak coverage)
maxmart.com.gh - domain does not resolve
jumia.com.gh / kikuu.com.gh (marketplaces) - not used
no readable Ghanaian health-food shop or baking/professional ingredient supplier could be identified without a working web search
CRP.notes: No dairy cream powder found; coverage of Ghanaian e-retail is weak (few readable shops).
